items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Well, there's still another brother between Mealy and Andrew. Oh yeah? And that's Adam.

ctx.x: Yeah, I understand. Excuse me, Paul. Let's stop a minute and check in. Okay. Well, I think the volume and everything sounds fine, so I think we can let it stay right there. You know, and just keep on talking, which is fine with me. Well, that's fascinating. You know, I never, I read the interview you had at Tulane, the interview they did with you and Mealy. Yeah. And then one that Barry Martin did and you never mentioned another brother. You know, you mentioned, I think you mentioned your father, I think.
Well, there's still another brother between Mealy and Andrew. Oh yeah? And that's Adam. See, they all passed away except me and I'm the one last. But actually, it was Emiel, after Emiel came Emily.
